access.zh: QwenCloud 与阿里云百炼 API；Qwen4-Max、Qwen3.8-Max 走闭源 API，Qwen4 家族的小模型后续开源（官方博客）。
access.en: QwenCloud and Alibaba Cloud Model Studio API; Qwen4-Max and Qwen3.8-Max run through the closed API, while smaller Qwen4 family models are promised for open source (official blog).

generations.zh: 2026-11-16 发布：2.4 万亿总参数、单 token 激活 710 亿（较 Qwen3.8-Max 少 25%）、原生视觉、100 万 token 上下文；官方称在编程、智能体任务与视觉推理上表现突出（阿里巴巴集团新闻稿）。
generations.en: Released on 2026-11-16: 2.4T total parameters, 71B active per token (25% fewer than Qwen3.8-Max), native vision and a 1M-token context; the official release says it stands out on coding, agentic tasks and visual reasoning (Alibaba Group newsroom).

generations.zh: 上一代旗舰：2.4 万亿参数 MoE，快照 qwen3.8-max-0902；官方同时宣布将开放 Qwen-Max 级权重（阿里云博客）。
generations.en: Previous flagship: 2.4T-parameter MoE with snapshot qwen3.8-max-0902; the official blog also announced that Qwen-Max-class weights would be opened.

generations.zh: 更早一代 Max：官方价格页仍在册，作为历史档位保留（QwenCloud 价格页）。
generations.en: Earlier Max generation: still listed in the official pricing page as a historical tier (QwenCloud pricing page).

v.zh: 2.4 万亿总参数（Qwen4-Max，官方新闻稿）；每个 token 激活 710 亿参数，较 Qwen3.8-Max 少 25%。
v.en: 2.4 trillion total parameters (Qwen4-Max, official release); 71B active per token, 25% fewer than Qwen3.8-Max.

v.zh: 原生视觉 + 文本；官方称支持图像与视频理解（官方模型文档）
v.en: Native vision plus text; the official model docs say it handles image and video understanding (official model docs)

v.zh: 按 Token Plan 或 API 用量计费，本站不抄具体数字；以 QwenCloud 价格页为准。
v.en: Billed through Token Plan or API usage; this site does not copy numbers — see the QwenCloud pricing page.

v.zh: 官方称 Code Arena 第 6，并在 Agents’ Last Exam、Vals Index、JobBench、Chartography 等专项测试中取得佳绩；均为厂商口径，未独立复现。
v.en: The official release claims 6th on Code Arena and strong results on Agents’ Last Exam, Vals Index, JobBench and Chartography; all vendor-reported, not independently reproduced.

v.zh: QwenCloud、QwenWork、Qoder、QwenStudio；企业走阿里云百炼（官方博客与云文档）。
v.en: QwenCloud, QwenWork, Qoder and QwenStudio; enterprises use Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (official blog and cloud docs).

positioning.zh: 国产闭源旗舰里参数规模最大的一档，且与开放权重线并行：Max 走 API，Qwen4 小模型后续开源。选型时把「API 条款」与「后续开放权重许可」分开读，不要把两者混成一个模型。
positioning.en: The largest domestic closed flagship by parameter count, running in parallel with an open-weight line: Max stays on the API while smaller Qwen4 models are promised for open source. Read API terms and the future open-weight licence separately; they are not one model.

onSite.zh: 开放权重侧这里收 qwen3-8 系列（谱系卡与量化对比）；Qwen4-Max 目前只有闭源 API，没有本地量化话题。
onSite.en: On the open-weight side this site covers the qwen3-8 series (family card and quantisation comparison); Qwen4-Max is API-only today, so local quantisation does not apply.
